s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis forecasts +50GW of datacenter capacity in 2027, supported by >24GW already in advanced construction and slightly under USD 1T of binding, non-cancellable leases signed in 2026, driving a surge in orders for industrial suppliers like Vertiv, ABB and Sterling Infrastructure. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

If the buildout lands near the forecast, named electrical and datacenter equipment suppliers would see order and revenue growth, but the article does not quantify the earnings or margin impact for any supplier.

header.sector: Datacenter construction, cooling, racks and physical inputs
header.title: AI datacenter buildout accelerates +50GW in 2027, lifting physical datacenter suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis forecasts +50GW of datacenter capacity in 2027, supported by >24GW already in advanced construction and slightly under USD 1T of binding, non-cancellable leases signed in 2026, driving a surge in orders for industrial suppliers like Vertiv, ABB and Sterling Infrastructure. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩
The article argues the acceleration is real and underappreciated, pointing investors to industrial suppliers forecast to see an order surge.

If the buildout lands near the forecast, named electrical and datacenter equipment suppliers would see order and revenue growth, but the article does not quantify the earnings or margin impact for any supplier.

items.text: More than 24GW of datacenters are in advanced stage of construction, most to be delivered in 2027
Year-to-date, slightly under USD 1 trillion of binding/non-cancellable datacenter leases have been signed ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩
The >24GW figure covers 40 campuses, a small share of several hundred sites in advanced construction
+50GW in a single year is roughly equal to the entire global cumulative datacenter market built through 2024 ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩
Datacenter developers typically spend only 5-10% of project capital before securing a customer
A typical datacenter pre-lease is a 15-20 year contract with total contract value of $30-50B per GW
